sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Norway – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary, not an official source: corporate tax 22% (25% in parts of the financial sector); petroleum taxation at a marginal 78% (22% plus a 56% special tax).

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Norway – Individual – Taxes on personal income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: general income taxed at a flat 22%, personal income charged bracket tax and national insurance contributions.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Norway – Corporate – Other taxes
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: VAT 25% general and 15% on food; employers’ national insurance 0% to 14.1% by municipality; financial activities tax 5%.
